req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint must: (1) return HTTP 200 with the updated task on valid input, (2) return HTTP 404 for non-existent task IDs, (3) support partial updates (only provided fields change), (4) enforce field constraints (title min_length=1, max_length=100, description max_length=500). Tests cover EP (normal update), NEG (missing task, invalid body), BVA (title at length boundaries 1 and 100 chars, description at 500 chars), STC (completed flag toggling false->true and true->false), and DT (partial vs full update combinations). Each test uses the pre-loaded seed data and an in-memory SQLite override to remain idempotent.

import os, pytest
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from datetime import datetime

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_body():
    engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    db = Session()
    db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54)))
    db.commit(); db.close()
    def override(): 
        s = Session(); 
        try: yield s
        finally: s.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug', 'description': 'All done', 'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert body['description'] == 'All done'
    assert body['completed'] == True
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_body()
